meta.title: Composio
meta.description: Use Composio apps from ohmydsh: four agent tools over the Composio CLI (search, execute, link, status), a Composio page for connections, a tool browser and trigger routes, and recipes that turn trigger events into a new session or a wake of an existing one. Trigger runs are restricted: actions outside a recipe's allowlist pause for your approval. Uses your Composio CLI login.
